title.narrative: Strengthening of Political Parties in Somaliland

description.narrative: Contract related to: Strengthening of Political Parties in Somaliland - In Somalia¿s Somaliland region, violent protests have occurred over a lack of consensus between the Government and opposition parties on the way ahead for elections. Presidential elections, elections of the Upper House and the renewal of the 10-year licenses of political parties are foreseen in 2022. Political parties lack mechanisms for inter-party cooperation and collaboration as well as effective structures, which could also foster greater inclusivity of women and youth. There are concerns, that disputes over the date of elections, the process of registration of new political associations, set against high political stakes and potentially increasing clan grievances, could spark further violent conflict. This action will support dialogue between political parties and with civil society as well as inclusive political parties and participation.

Futhermore the government were insisting on using the BVVS system as they were claiming that the opposition parties possess more voter cards from the conflict eastern regions and that its necessary to have voter identification system BVVS. However NEC was able to end this conflict and convince all the political stockholders by using and sharing the findings of the NEC system audit which was fully supported by NIMD.
